sentences.text: If you seal a steel tube and drop it in the sea, you have a submarine.
But it just floats and bobs on the surface.
So you add tanks that flood with sea water, and it sinks.
But now it keeps sinking until it sits stuck on the bottom.
So you add tanks of air that blow the water out, and it rises.
Flood the tanks to dive, and blow them to rise.
But deep down, the pressure squeezes the hull until it cracks.
So you wrap it in a thick hull of strong steel.
Navy attack submarines dive deeper than 800 feet, and the exact depth is secret.
Add a periscope and a propeller.
Congratulations, you have built a submarine.
